title: Willie Edwards and Kid Punch
summary: Dawson never worked with Edwards and says Punch came from Raceland.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Well there was one more trumpet player I had on my list to ask about, it's Edwards. Edwards, Edwards, remember wasn't there one Ralph? Willie Edwards? Is it Willie Edwards or something? Willie Edwards. It was a dead-barred clam, I don't think we got it mixed up. I think Punch talked about Willie Edwards. Yeah, Willie Edwards and stuff. Do you remember?

Edwards, I didn't hear the fellas called Edwards. You never worked with him? No, I never worked with him. It might be some of Punch's. Might have been some fella from uptown around Punch's way, you know, because Punch came, he's from the country, you know Punch. He's from Raceland. Yeah, from Raceland. That's where he come from out there. He came here practically lived uptown all, you know what happened, he came here.
